environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy includes a condition key restricting invoke access. The AuthType is set to AWS_IAM with the function URL's resource-based policy containing only a principal allowance for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/internal-api-gateway-role with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. The invoke permission (lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl) is scoped with FunctionUrlAuthType=AWS_IAM. Additionally, the ECS task runs in a private subnet with no internet-facing ALB or NAT gateway path that exposes the function URL directly. The function URL DNS resolves but SigV4 signature validation occurs at the Lambda service layer before the request reaches the handler code. Note: the container itself has no network-level firewall rules blocking inbound - the auth gate is purely at the Lambda Function URL IAM auth layer which validates signatures before forwarding.

config.network: private subnet, no public ingress path
